title: VahanRecord
description: VAHAN (National Vehicle Registry) table schema - stores vehicle registration, blacklist status, and theft alerts

plate_number.description: Primary Key: Normalized vehicle registration plate number (e.g. GJ01AB1234)

vehicle_class.description: Vehicle classification e.g. Motor Car (LMV), 2 Wheeler, Heavy Goods Vehicle

owner_name.description: Full name of the registered vehicle owner

blacklist_status.description: Current RTO blacklist or seizure enforcement notice

stolen_flag.description: Flag set to true if vehicle has active theft report filed with police

linked_fir.description: Police First Information Report (FIR) reference if stolen or under investigation, else null
